Predict Positive-Class Probabilities

Source: R/rf_class_prob.R
rf_class_predict_prob_fast.Rd

Generates estimated probabilities for class 1 from a binary random forest fitted with rf_class_fit_fast().

Usage

rf_class_predict_prob_fast(X, forest_list)

Arguments

X

A numeric matrix containing predictor values. The columns must correspond, in number and order, to the predictors used to fit forest_list.

forest_list

A fitted binary-classification forest returned by rf_class_fit_fast().

Value

A numeric vector of length nrow(X). Each element is the estimated probability that the corresponding observation belongs to class 1. Returned values are between zero and one.

Examples

set.seed(872)

X <- cbind(
  x1 = rnorm(30),
  x2 = rnorm(30)
)

y <- as.integer(
  X[, "x1"] + X[, "x2"] > 0
)

forest <- rf_class_fit_fast(
  X,
  y,
  n_trees = 10,
  max_depth = 3
)

probabilities <- rf_class_predict_prob_fast(
  X,
  forest
)

head(probabilities)
#> [1] 0.2750000 1.0000000 0.7000000 0.9000000 1.0000000 0.2666667

stopifnot(
  is.numeric(probabilities),
  is.null(dim(probabilities)),
  length(probabilities) == nrow(X),
  all(is.finite(probabilities)),
  all(probabilities >= 0),
  all(probabilities <= 1)
)
